title: Built Smacked Right Back
style: global pop celebration, 116 BPM, joyful multicultural energy, different greetings per verse, world percussion, PLUGGED education theme, call and response, male vocal warm and inviting, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
Song idea: “Built Smacked Right Back”

Hook / chorus
Built smacked right back, yeah the terminal said that
No stop-and-chat bot, we don’t drift like that
Sweet ride, hard line, text hit then snapped back
Got the stack in motion and we never go slack

Verse idea
You felt the page turn, felt the whole thing click
Not a napkin plan, not a skeleton trick
When the signal comes through, let the whole thing sing
From the spine to the site, let the true notes ring

Style
Punchy electro-rock / phonk-pop hybrid, confident male vocal, chantable chorus, sharp stop-start rhythm, triumphant build.
